task: Rename URL to Hostname in AzureDevOps credential type, reorder fields (hostname/org/project/PAT), enforce hostname+org+PAT as mandatory, keep project optional, and add backward-compatible fallback for existing DB entries using the old 'url' storage key.

key_reasoning.reason: Change spans 4 distinct layers: REST API model (AzureDevOpsCredentials in rest_api/models/settings.py), service layer (SettingsService.AZURE_DEVOPS_FIELDS + get_azure_devops_creds()), tool/config layer (GenericAzureDevOpsConfig + 4 tool config classes: Wiki, WorkItem, TestPlan, AzureDevOpsGit), and the datasource/loader layer (AzureDevOpsWikiLoader, AzureDevOpsWorkItemLoader).

Backward-compat fallback for existing stored credentials is the primary risk: all live integrations store key 'url'; renaming without a dual-key lookup or AliasChoices fallback silently breaks them at runtime. Loader URL construction (bare hostname vs full URL with scheme) is a second non-trivial risk affecting all datasource processing jobs. Red flag applied: 'Requires data migration' bumped Technical Risk from M(3) to L(4).
